items.title: The Quiet Hours
items.description: Most of what we remember about our own lives happens in the margins — the hours no one was watching, including us. What we call attention is usually the absence of its opposite.

items.title: A Letter About Rain
items.description: My grandmother kept a rain journal. Thirty-one years of weather in tidy columns. It was the most useful and the most useless book I have ever read.

items.title: The Map Is Not the City
